note: The case of the FIRST letter of a text, language-independent (spec/translation-file/casing.md): the first code point only; Unicode's simple mapping with SpecialCasing's unconditional ones laid over it; a capital is the titlecase, else the uppercase; a first character with no case leaves the text as it is. Unicode version: Casing.UnicodeVersion, equal to the mod's. The tables a port reads are corpus/data/first-letter.json.

upper_first.out: the text with its first letter as a capital

lower_first.out: the text with its first letter as a small letter

lower.out: the WHOLE text in small letters: each code point its SIMPLE lower case (UnicodeData field 13), none crossing ASCII
